description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Uva Paranagama, Madulla, Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about elected positions.
